channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US and Saudi Arabia strike ‘Iran-aligned’ groups in Iraq
item.description: The US and Saudi Arabia launched joint air strikes on Iraq, targeting ‘Iran-aligned’ groups.

item.title: Iran and Oman swap proposals to manage Strait of Hormuz: What we know
item.description: Iran is proposing a deal that would see it have significantly more control than Oman.

item.title: Iran attacks US bases in Middle East as Trump meets Netanyahu
item.description: Iran has also struck three ships in the Strait of Hormuz and rejected Oman’s proposal on managing the waterway.

item.title: Trump meets Netanyahu for a record seventh White House visit
item.description: Donald Trump and Benjamin Netanyahu met at the White House for the first time since launching the war on Iran.

item.title: Iran missiles target US forces in Jordan after a five-day pause in war
item.description: The US military says it has successfully intercepted a barrage of missiles fired by Iran at its troops in Jordan.

item.title: Iraqi armed groups condemn ‘dangerous escalation’ after US-Saudi strikes
item.description: Riyadh says its targeted attacks were done in coordination with the US military.

item.title: Iran war live: 20 killed in US-Saudi attack on Iraq; IRGC targets Jordan
item.description: Attacks come as Saudi Arabia intercepts drones and Iran warns of 'any action' to maintain its control of Hormuz Strait.

item.title: Japan in a ‘race against time’ to rescue people trapped beneath rubble after quake
item.description: At least 13 people have been killed after the earthquake struck the island of Kyushu on Tuesday.

item.title: Saudi Arabia joins US in strikes on Iran-backed militias in Iraq
item.description: US Central Command says proxy groups launched attacks against US bases and Saudi energy infrastructure.

item.title: Zelensky and Netanyahu meet Trump as wars in Ukraine and Iran drag on
item.description: The two leaders sound encouraged after holding back-to-back bilaterals at the White House.
